steps.title: Sample Collection
steps.instruction: Use a sterile blade to scrape 220 mg of faecal material from the outside surface of a stool and transfer it into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Sample Homogenization
steps.instruction: Grind the faecal material into powder using liquid nitrogen in a mortar.

steps.title: Buffer Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract the ground faeces using InhibitEX buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μL of InhibitEX buffer to the mortar, grind and mix, then transfer the liquid back into the 2 mL tube.
Add another 500 μL of InhibitEX buffer to the mortar to collect any leftover material and transfer the liquid back into the 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Homogenization and Pelleting
steps.instruction: Homogenize and centrifuge the sample to pellet stool particles.

substeps.instruction: Vortex continuously for 1 min or until the solid material is thoroughly homogenised.
Centrifuge at 20,000 g (~14,000 rpm) for 2 min.

steps.title: Lysis Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysis mixture in a new 2 mL tube.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 25 μL of Proteinase K into a new 2 mL tube.
Pipette 800 μL of supernatant from the centrifuged homogenate into the tube containing Proteinase K.
Add 800 μL of Buffer AL and vortex for 15 s.

steps.title: Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 70°C for 10 min, then centrifuge briefly to remove drops from the inside of the tube lid.

steps.title: Ethanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Split the lysate and add ethanol to precipitate DNA.

substeps.instruction: Split the lysate into two 2 mL tubes (~813 μL per tube).
Add 400 µL of 99.9% ethanol to each tube and mix by vortexing.

steps.title: DNA Binding
steps.instruction: Load the lysate onto the QIAamp spin column.

substeps.instruction: Carefully apply 600 μL of lysate to the QIAamp spin column.
Close the cap and centrifuge at 20,000 g (~14,000 rpm) for 1 min.
Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube and discard the filtrate.
Repeat these steps until all lysate has been loaded on the column.

steps.title: Column Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the spin column to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Buffer AW1 to the column, centrifuge at 20,000 g (~14,000 rpm) for 1 min, then discard the filtrate using a new 2 mL collection tube.
Add 500 µL of Buffer AW2 to the column, centrifuge at 20,000 g (~14,000 rpm) for 3 min, then discard the filtrate using a new 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge the column again at 20,000 g (~14,000 rpm) for 3 min to eliminate Buffer AW2 carryover.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the spin column into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf LoBind microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the column into a new, labelled 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Pipette 100 µL of Buffer ATE directly onto the QIAamp membrane.
Incubate for 1 min at room temperature (15°C to 25°C).
Centrifuge at 20,000 g (~14,000 rpm) for 1 min.

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: Store the DNA isolate at -20°C for use within a week or at -80°C for longer-term storage.
